doc: The private smoothstep t^2 (3 - 2 t), t = clip((x - a) / (b - a), 0, 1), on x in [-1, 10] for the edge pairs of inputs.a and inputs.b: the climate pairs (2, 2.6) and (1, 2), the (0, 8) of texture.py, the unit pair (0, 1) and a reversed one (a=1, b=0), which the code never uses but the formula defines. Both clip ends are taken. Float64: rtol 1e-9, atol 1e-12.
